_info: Legendary effects (source: afkmeta.com/en/deskrawl/legendaries). model: stats = stat bonus while active, uptime = share of time it is active (estimate), elements = only counts if your damage element is listed, special = custom rule, manual = cannot be computed (skill-specific etc.); set your own value in the tracker (Bewertung tab).
